page.overview:
Who is Abruzzi of Sartosa?

Abruzzi of Sartosa was an influential figure of Sartosa in ancient Tilea, long before the city was known as a lair of pirates.

He was a stiff-necked, heavy-faced man, and he often looked uncomfortable in his coarse robes of state as once he was a gruff soldier.

The palazzo where he lived was a monument to the alliance of form and function in the rich district of the city. The walled garden was open to the sky and water burbled in the aqueducts that ran along the top of the walls. There were thick, fleshy plants and brightly colored flowers everywhere, and caged songbirds sang sweetly. In contrast with the smelly effluvium of the dungeons beneath the garden.

In –1020 IC he managed to make a deal with Neferata in the guise of a woman from Cathay. In exchange for a seat in the Senate for a protege of hers, Neferata would have helped the island of Sartosa to break free from Dark Elf raids and consolidate her position against Araby, the second maritime power of the time, all without having to shed Sartosan blood.
